items.prompt: A backtest achieves excellent filled-only VWAP slippage but fills half the parent quantity. What should be reported?
items.modelAnswer: Requested/filled/unfilled/open/canceled quantities and timing, benchmark window/data policy, costs and remaining exposure/opportunity risk. Favorable partial-fill price alone does not establish total execution quality or safe completion.

criteria.text: Reports completion/exposure as well as price.
Does not treat targets as fills.
